name: Skeels Electric Co
old_description: Founded in 1914, Skeels Electric Company in Bismarck North Dakota
about:
Founded in 1914 in Bismarck, North Dakota, Skeels Electric Company is a multigenerational, family-owned electrical contractor that has served the region for over a century.

The company provides commercial, industrial, residential, and communications wiring services, along with electrical panel upgrades and energy and lighting audits. Its work spans new construction, renovations, and maintenance for institutional, commercial, and industrial facilities as well as private homes.

Skeels Electric serves a broad customer base that includes commercial property owners, institutional campuses, industrial plants, and residential clients across North Dakota. Projects range from office buildings and schools to manufacturing facilities and single-family homes, with communications infrastructure such as data and voice wiring also in scope.

According to the company, its differentiation rests on a focus on customer service, the use of high-quality products, employment of trained professionals, and maintenance of safe work environments. These practices are intended to ensure that jobs are completed on time and on budget, with a commitment to exceeding expectations from concept through design, construction, completion, and post-project support.
